title: Säännöstelypatojen sulkuluukkujen suunnittelu
description: Säännöstelypatojen sulkuluukkujen suunnittelu Suunnittelutyö sisältää kolmen padon sulkuluukkuelementtien rakennussuunnittelun tarjouspyyntöaineistossa kuvatussa laajuudessa. • Malkakosken säännöstelypadon sulkuluukut • Varpulan säännöstelypadon purkupuolen sulkuluukut • Hirvijärven hätäpurkuaukon sulkuluukku Suunniteltavat luukut on tarkoitettu käytettäviksi patojen tulevissa kuivatöissä, kuten huolto-, tarkastus-, korjaus- ja kuntotutkimustoimenpiteiden yhteydessä. Suunnittelussa tulee huomioida luukkujen turvallinen käyttö, asennettavuus, rakenteellinen kestävyys sekä soveltuvuus padon nykyisiin rakenteisiin ja käyttöolosuhteisiin. Suunnittelu on suoritettava viimeistään seuraavassa esitetyn aikataulun mukaisesti. 1) Luonnoskuvat ja lujuuslaskelmat tarkastettavaksi: • Varpula 29.1.2027 • Hirvijärvi 15.2.2027 • Malkakoski 26.2.2027 2) Lopulliset valmistuskuvat ja dokumentaatio luovutettu: • Varpula 15.2.2027 • Hirvijärvi 26.2.2027 • Malkakoski 15.3.2027 3) Työn tulee olla valmiina ja tilaajalle luovutettuna viimeistään: • Varpula 26.2.2027 • Hirvijärvi 15.3.2027 • Malkakoski 30.3.2027 Suunnittelun lopputuloksena laaditaan täysin valmiit valmistus-, hankinta-, asennus- ja käyttökelpoiset suunnitelma-asiakirjat, joiden perusteella sulkuluukkuelementit voidaan kilpailuttaa, valmistaa, asentaa ja ottaa käyttöön ilman erillistä jatko- tai täydentävää suunnittelua. Suunnittelun tulee sisältää myös valmistuksen kannalta tarpeelliset kokoonpano-, osa-, detalji-, hitsaus- ja asennuspiirustukset sekä materiaaliluettelot. Rakenteellisen kestävyyden osoittamiseksi suunnitteluun tulee sisältyä tarvittavat lujuus- ja vakavuuslaskelmat. Suunnittelutyö kuluineen veloitetaan kokonaishintaisena. Hankinnassa noudatetaan Konsulttitoiminnan yleisiä sopimusehtoja KSE 2013. Suunnittelijan tulee tutustua kohteisiin ja käytettävissä olevaan lähtöaineistoon sekä tarvittaessa esittää hankkeen toteutuksen kannalta perusteltuja teknisiä ratkaisuja ja vaihtoehtoja. Suunnittelijan vastuulla on varmistaa ennen suunnitelmien luovutusta, että suunnitellut luukkurakenteet ovat valmistettavissa tavanomaisin konepajamenetelmin, kuljetettavissa kohteisiin, asennettavissa turvallisesti sekä käytettävissä suunnitellussa käyttötarkoituksessa. Suunnittelussa tulee huomioida patoturvallisuuslainsäädäntö, voimassa olevat viranomaismääräykset sekä soveltuvat eurokoodit ja muut suunnittelua koskevat tekniset ohjeet. Tarjouspyynnön liitteenä on tilaajan ottamia valokuvia, jotka on tarkoitettu vain kohteiden hahmottamiseen tarjousta varten. Voittaneen toimittajan tulee ennen suunnittelun aloittamista suorittaa kohteissa luukkukohtaiset mittaukset ja varmistaa suunniteltavien luukkujen toimivuus. Tilaaja pidättää oikeuden hylätä tarjoukset hankintalainsäädännön sallimilla perusteilla sekä keskeyttää hankinnan perustellusta syystä.,

title: Slovenia – Construction work – UREDITEV CESTNE POVEZAVE JEVNICA – SENOŽETI IN PROTIPOPLAVNA UREDITEV VODOTOKA JEVNICA VKLJUČNO Z NADOMESTITVENIMI OBJEKTI (UJMA 2023) - SKLOP A: NADOMESTITVENI MOST ČEZ REKO SAVO
description: Občina Litija načrtuje izvedbo gradbeno-obrtniških in inštalacijskih del 1. faze projekta »Ureditev cestne povezave Jevnica – Senožeti in protipoplavna ureditev vodotoka Jevnica vključno z nadomestitvenimi objekti (UJMA 2023)«. Predmet naročila je izgradnja nadomestitvenega cestnega mostu čez reko Savo v Jevnici. Most bo temeljen na uvrtanih AB kolih, njegova prekladna konstrukcija pa bo škatlastega prereza iz prednapetega betona. Izvedena bo delno na podpornem odru in delno po tehnologiji prostokonzolne gradnje. Dela vključujejo tudi ležišča, dilatacije, hidroizolacijo, vozišče, opremo mostu in obremenilni preizkus. Obstoječi most z leseno prekladno konstrukcijo bo porušen po tehnološkem elaboratu rušenja in ob nadzoru Zavoda za varstvo kulturne dediščine Slovenije. Naročilo obsega še ureditev pripadajoče lokalne ceste LC 208283 Jevnica – Senožeti v obsegu 1. faze, vključno z deviacijama B in C, odvodnjavanjem ter prometno opremo in signalizacijo. Izvesti je treba tudi inundacijski prepust, cestno razsvetljavo z NN priključkom in začasno prometno ureditev v času gradnje. Podrobnejši opis predmeta naročila je v razpisni dokumentaciji.

title: Tier 2 Adult Weight Management Service 2027
description: This procurement is being conducted in accordance with the Health Care Services (Provider Selection Regime) Regulations 2023. Hampshire County Council's Public Health is seeking to procure a tier 2 adult weight management service designed to meet the needs of eligible Hampshire residents, based on National Institute of Health and Care Excellence (NICE) guidelines. The service will be in two lots. Lot 1: Universal service a) A tier two weight management service, delivered face to face, at accessible venues across Hampshire along with a remote service (group or individual service) for people unable to access physical venues. The Provider will be expected to provide the service at a minimum of 70 locations across the County of Hampshire. b) A physical activity based tier 2 weight management service in which the behaviour change components of the tier 2 model are delivered alongside a physical activity intervention (co-determined by Commissioner and Provider) for male-only, female-only and mixed-sex groups. The Provider will be expected to provide the service at at a minimum of 70 locations across the County of Hampshire. Lot 2: Specialist service Specialist tier two weight management services for defined health inequalities groups a) A specialist tier two weight management service, for people living with a severe mental illness. The service will be delivered face to face, at accessible venues across Hampshire. The Provider will be expected to provide the service at a minimum of five locations across the County of Hampshire. b) A specialist tier two weight management service, for people living with a learning disability. The service will be delivered face to face, at accessible venues across Hampshire. The Provider will be expected to provide the service at at a minimum of five locations across the County of Hampshire.

description:
Le projet EP18 Balerna prévoit une intervention globale d’entretien du tronçon autoroutier N02, compris entre la douane de Chiasso-Brogeda (km -0.100) et le viaduc de la Tana à Mendrisio (km 6.357).


Le «Lot 202, travaux préparatoires en tant qu'entrepreneur en bâtiment» comprend la réalisation des ouvrages suivants :

- préparation de la surface principale de chantier ;

- réalisation de nouvelles batteries de tubes pour les tracés de câbles de la N2 ;

- revêtement du terre-plein central de la N2 ;

- réfection des revêtements bitumineux des giratoires de Bellavista et de Pontegana, au niveau de la jonction de Chiasso-Balerna.


Principales quantités prévues :

- démontage de glissières de sécurité : env. 440 m ;

- fraisage et enlèvement de revêtements bitumineux : env. 900 t ;

- caniveaux de drainage : env. 500 m ;

- réalisation de nouveaux blocs de tubes pour les tracés de câbles : env. 970 m ;

- grave non traitée : env. 1'800 m³ ;

- exécution de la planie : env. 3'100 m² ;

- fourniture et mise en œuvre d’enrobé bitumineux AC 8 H : env. 120 t ;

- fourniture et mise en œuvre d’enrobé bitumineux AC B 22 H : env. 640 t ;

- fourniture et mise en œuvre d’enrobé bitumineux AC T 22 H : env. 680 t ;

- fourniture et mise en œuvre d’enrobé bitumineux MA 11 H : env. 25 t.

title: France – Plant upgrade work – Marché Public Global de Performance sur les bâtiments communaux de la Ville de Miribel
description: La présente consultation concerne un Marché Global de Performance (MGP) passé selon la procédure du Dialogue Compétitif pour la conception-réalisation, l’exploitation-maintenance de 9 bâtiments et installations municipaux à rénover. Afin de garantir la bonne atteinte, mais également le respect dans le temps des performances, la contractualisation sous la forme d'un contrat global de performance énergétique est recherchée. De manière à garantir le meilleur choix, d’un point de vue technique, financier et opérationnel, ce contrat global est passé par la voie d’une procédure menée en dialogue compétitif. Le marché a donc pour objet : • les études de conception, • la réalisation des travaux, • ainsi que l’exploitation et la maintenance des bâtiments et installations concernées. • l’atteinte d’objectifs de performance énergétique contractualisés, • la réalisation de travaux fonctionnels sur certains sites, destinés à améliorer la qualité d’usage et les conditions d’accueil. Le recours à la procédure de dialogue compétitif est justifié par l’existence de prestations de conception et compte tenu de la nature du besoin ne pouvant être satisfait sans l’adaptation de solutions immédiatement disponibles.

title: Germany – Works for complete or part construction and civil engineering work – Generalunternehmerleistungen DZNE CTU - Clinical Trial Unit Rostock
description: Gegenstand der Vergabe ist die vollständige, funktionsfähige Errichtung einschließlich Fertigstellung einer Clinical Trial Unit (DZNE CTU) in Rostock als freistehender, dreigeschossiger Holzhybridbau. Der kubische Baukörper mit Abmessungen von ca. 23,80 m × 17,50 m wird ohne Unterkellerung errichtet. Vorgesehen ist eine Skeletttragstruktur mit nichttragenden, vorgefertigten Außenwänden in Holzrahmenbauweise. Das Gebäude dient der Durchführung klinischer Studien sowie der wissenschaftlichen Erprobung neuer Therapieverfahren im Frühstadium neurodegenerativer Erkrankungen. Die Nutzung umfasst Untersuchungs- und Diagnostikräume, einen Schwesternstützpunkt, Laborräume zur Aufbereitung biologischer Proben, Bettenzimmer zur kurzfristigen Beobachtung sowie einen Smart-Home-Bereich mit kleiner Wohnung für umfassende Monitoring-Studien. Die Generalunternehmerleistung umfasst die zur Realisierung des Bauvorhabens erforderlichen Bau-, Koordinations-, Prüf-, Abnahme-, Dokumentations- und Inbetriebnahmeleistungen, einschließlich der Planung gemäß der HOAI Leistungsphasen 5, 8 und 9, auf Basis der vom Generalplaner erbrachten Entwurfs- und Genehmigungsplanung.

title: TOBYHANNA ARMY DEPOT EMF RANGE EXPANSION- INDUSTRY DAY
description: Notice: Industry Day Project Name: MILCON TYAD Radar Test Range Expansion Installation: Tobyhanna Army Depot Address: 11 Hap Arnold Boulevard Tobyhanna, PA 18466-5076 Building: Visitor Control Center Entry requirements: RealID and/or US Passport Tentative Date: 16 Dec 2026 Time: 1000 Scope of Work: The project entails expansion of existing EMF Range facilities on Powder Smoke Ridge at Tobyhanna Army Depot. The major items of work to be performed are the following: Construct embankment from imported, compacted fill, supported in part by a Mechanically Stabilized Earth (MSE) wall, to provide the grades necessary for the new radome pad and other site features. The estimated imported fill quantity is approximately 400,000 cubic yards. Construct the radome foundation and support walls on an elevated concrete pad. The top elevation of the pad shall be 2135 feet above sea level. The concrete pad is a three-lobed irregular shape approximately 68,000 SF in area. Erect the Radome radar enclosure, approximately 110 feet in diameter, using government supplied materials. Construct two circular concrete expansion pads for the radome pads existing on-site. Construct two operational concrete test pads adjacent to the existing radome access road. Pad sizes are approximately 68,000 SF and 13,000 SF in area. Construct a 20 foot x 30 foot range (approximate size) control building adjacent to the new radome area. The building will contain workstations, storage for hard drives and removable media related to the radar units which will be stored while not in use, and a restroom. The building will be designed to allow for the storage of classified material. Construct an approximate 4,480 SF addition to Building 54. Construct a paved access road to connect the new radome pad with the existing radome access road. Construct a gravel improved, temporary access road along the fire break adjacent to Powder Smoke Ridge to facilitate truck access to the site for the delivery of fill materials needed to raise the radome to the required elevation, and other equipment and material access. Demolition of a metal test stand behind Building 54. Weather Station: Construct a weather station on Powder Smoke Ridge to provide weather calibration data to radar units on the ridge. Utility Work (includes but is not limited to): Connect the radome and range control building to the existing electrical and communications infrastructure on Powder Smoke Ridge. Construct a potable water line from Building 54 to provide water to the range control building. Construct sanitary holding tanks at the range control building and the Building 54 addition. Incidental work includes, but is not limited to, clearing/tree cutting, new and connections to existing utilities, site and building lighting misc. paving, pavement striping, sidewalks, building gutters, storm drainage facilities, soil and sediment erosion control features, topsoil and seeding, guide rail, fence replacement and miscellaneous site demolition. -- NOTE--- A PDF copy of this Industry Day Notice is also attached for your reference. Please note that this announcement and notice are subject to amendment. Additional details and updates may be provided over the coming week or prior to the scheduled Industry Day at Tobyhanna Army Depot. Interested parties are encouraged to monitor SAM.gov regularly for updates, amendments, and any additional information or instructions pertaining to the Industry Day.

title: Y1DA--Project620-22-110 Replace and Upgrade Fire alarm System at Montrose VAMC
description: This notice is for Solicitation Number 36C24227B0009, Project Number 620-22-110 Replace Fire Alarm Campus Wide at the VA Hudson Valley Health Care System, Montrose Campus, 2094 Albany Post Road, Montrose, New York 10548. This shall be a 100% Service Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) Set-Aside. As a result, all SDVOSBs may submit a bid, which will be considered by the agency. This project is classified under NAICS Code 238210 and has a size standard of $19 Million. The Magnitude of Construction for this project is between $2,000,000.00 and $5,000,000.00 Scope of Work: The scope of work shall generally consist of, but not limited to the following: The contractor will furnish all materials, equipment, supervision, and personnel necessary to complete the job to upgrade the fire alarm system campus wide at FDR VA Medical Center, Montrose Campus. General Construction: The existing Edwards system (EST) is unreliable and experiencing frequent trouble and supervisory signals associated with either the field devices or the modules within the control panels. This project will replace the existing Fire alarm system with the latest (2026) Honeywell s Notifier Fire alarm system with Intelligent addressable technology. These fire alarm devices will be able to report back to the main fire alarm command Control panel and notify the system as to the actual sensitivity setting and when they need to be cleaned and calibrated. The addressable control modules will also be used for typical control functions as releasing locked doors, Elevator controls, and shutdown of HVAC fan units. This is a multi-phased project that will upgrade the existing fire alarm system at the facility. Upon project completion, the VA will have addressed all deficiencies with the current fire alarm system. The upgraded system is designed to meet all NFPA codes and current guidelines. Project Completion: 550 Calendar Days from Notice to Proceed (NTP). All other details and information shall be contained in the solicitation which shall be posted on www.sam.gov. The solicitation will be released on or about November 12, 2026. The response submittal address, date and time will be included in the solicitation. This project requires bonding and all responses/submissions to the solicitation to be posted later shall be emailed. No hand-carried bids will be accepted. All prospective bidders must be currently registered in www.sam.gov , www.dnb.com (Duns and Bradstreet )and be registered and verified as a Service Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) in https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ at the time of offer submission and before award of this procurement. End of Description.

title: Réhabilitation du collège d'Yvorne - travaux d'électricité
description:
Construit entre 1870 et 1871 par François Jaquerod, le Collège d'Yvorne est un bâtiment historique recensé en note 2. Le projet vise à adapter l'édifice aux besoins scolaires actuels tout en préservant ses qualités architecturales et sa substance patrimoniale.


Concept structurel 


Le projet prévoit un renforcement parasismique du bâtiment, notamment par l'amélioration des liaisons entre les planchers et les murs porteurs, ainsi que par des renforcements ponctuels de ces derniers. La nouvelle cage d'ascenseur participe également à la stabilisation générale de l'édifice


Sécurité 



La cage d'escalier historique sera adaptée pour constituer la voie de fuite verticale du bâtiment. Les dispositions prévues visent notamment à conserver les portes historiques et à aménager les vestiaires en dehors des voies de fuite.


Concept de rénovation énergétique 


 


Le projet prévoit le remplacement des fenêtres par du triple vitrage, l'application d'un crépi isolant de 3 cm, une isolation intérieure ciblée ainsi que l'isolation des planchers sur sous-sol et sous combles. Ces mesures visent à améliorer les performances énergétiques tout en préservant la substance historique.

 


Aménagement d’un couvert extérieur


 

Un couvert extérieur avec intégration de panneaux photovoltaïques est intégré sur une autre parcelle. Lié à une zone de verdure elle lie le collège avec un espace plus végétale. 


Accès


Les trois entrées historiques du rez-de-chaussée sont conservées. Un nouvel ascenseur est intégré dans la zone des sanitaires existants, permettant de garantir l'accessibilité aux personnes à mobilité réduite tout en préservant la cage d'escalier historique et son apport de lumière naturelle.

title: Ireland – Services related to noise pollution – Single Party Framework Agreement for Consultancy Services for the Preparation of Strategic Noise Mapping and Noise Action Plans for Round 5 of the Environmental Noise Regulations 2018 2021
description: This Tender relates to the establishment of a Single Operator Framework Agreement for the provision of consultancy services for the preparation of Strategic Noise Maps and Noise Action Plans for Round 5 of the Environmental Noise Regulations 2018-2021 [The Regulations], using the CNOSSOS-EU methodology. The Framework may be used by the Noise Mapping Bodies (NMBs) and Action Planning Authorities (APAs) designated under the Regulations that are responsible for road and rail noise sources only and or the LGMA. A list of the authorities that may use this Framework is set out in the Participants Bodies section. This Framework will be established through the award of an initial contract, which will relate solely to the Dublin Agglomeration. Dublin City Council will act as the Contracting Authority for this initial contract and be responsible for the establishment and overall administration of the Framework Agreement. Detailed specifications will be prepared for any subsequent contracts to be tendered as Supplementary Request for Tender under the framework. Additional contracts may include scope of services that cover all or any part of the scope of services set out below and cover other agglomerations (Cork or Limerick) or major road or major rail extents for any single NMB/APA or a combination of several NMBs/APAs. The scope of services covered by this Framework and 1st contract includes, but is not necessarily limited to, the following; Phase 1 Noise Modelling and Mapping; Data Review, Collection and Processing for the Noise Model; Processing of Road; Traffic Data Sets and Preparation of Road Traffic Model for reference year 2026; Noise Modelling and Preparation of Strategic Noise Maps for the following noise sources to a CNOSSOS-EU Methodology (Road Traffic; Rail Traffic; Industry); Population Exposure and Harmful Effects Assessment; Preparation of Relevant Project Reports; Stakeholder Engagement; Publish Strategic Noise Maps and Support Contracting Authority with Public Engagement; Reporting to EPA in line with EEA reporting requirements; Phase 2 Noise Action Plan; Identification and review of Important Areas (IAs), Most Important Areas (MIAs) and Priority Important Areas (PIAs), in line with EPA Guidance; Identification and Review of Potential Candidate Quiet Areas (PCQAs) and Candidate Quiet Areas (CQAs), in line with EPA guidance, including consideration of soundscape issues and assessment; Noise Action Plan Preparation including (Review of national policy and planning legislation and documents; Noise reduction measures); Collaboration with NMBs and Stakeholders; Screening for Strategic Environmental Assessment (SEA) and SEA (if required); Screening for Appropriate Assessment (AA) and Natura Impact Report (if required); Public and Stakeholder Consultation; Reporting to the EPA in line with EEA reporting requirements; General Phases 1 and 2; Project Meetings; Deliverables and Documentation; Project Management. For further information please refer to documentation available to download from www.etenders.gov.ie Resource ID 9527816; Please note that this project is subject to funding."

title: Ireland – Engineering works and construction works – Multi-Party Framework of Work Contractors for delivery of road infrastructure associated with Housing Activation in County Wexford Initial Project Ballynagee Link Road, Wexford Town
description: FRAMEWORK: It is envisaged that during the lifetime of the framework, there will be a number of Works Contracts for the delivery of road infrastructure associated with Housing Activation in County Wexford. Potential contracts include (but are not limited to): - Ballynage Link Road, Wexford Town - Circa 1.3km - Turrets Rock, Enniscorthy - Circa 0.4km - Milehouse to Moyne, Enniscorthy - Circa 2km - and any other similar projects that arise during the lifetime of the Framework WCC reserves the right to procure works for these and other similar works contract using separate procurement processes if so desired. The Framework Agreements will be issued for a term of four (4) years (“the Term”). It is envisaged that the maximum cumulative value of contracts awarded during the lifetime of the framework is €60m excluding VAT. WCC shall be entitled to terminate the Framework Agreement in the event that a Framework Agreement for Works Contractors is put in place by the Office of Government Procurement during the term of the Framework Agreement and in the case of such termination no compensation shall be payable for any loss (including consequential loss) that may be suffered by a Tenderer as a result of such termination INITIAL CONTRACT - BALLYNAGEE LINK ROAD The proposed development will comprise a new suburban link road, approximately 1.3km in length, connecting the L3016 Starvehall Road (Whiterock Hill) to the southern arm of the existing Ballynagee/ Scholars Way roundabout, located south of the R733 in the townland of Ballynagee, Wexford. The initial works contract comprises of: •A new single carriageway road with footpaths and segregated off-road cycle tracks on both sides. Approximately 6.5m wide carriageway consisting of two 3.25m wide traffic lanes, a 2m wide cycle track, a 2m wide footpath and varying widths of verges and rain gardens. •Junctions providing access to individual zoned land parcels, Loreto Secondary School, connection to Ballynagee/ Scholars Way roundabout, and to the L3016 Starvehall Road (Whiterock Hill); •Pedestrian zebra crossing on a raised table with tactile paving and cycle crossings at junctions and other key locations; •Two bus lay-bys adjacent to Loreto Secondary School; •An attenuation pond within the Min Ryan Park; •Culverts for existing stream/ land drains, including associated stream realignment works; •Surface water drainage infrastructure, including Sustainable Drainage Systems (SuDS) and rain garden features; •Watermain and foul sewer infrastructure to facilitate future development lands; •ESB infrastructure to facilitate future development lands; •Telecommunications infrastructure to facilitate future development lands; •Energy efficient public lighting and miscellaneous utility ducting; •Traffic signage and road markings; •Landscaping works and any boundary treatments; and •Accommodation works such as provision of environmental noise barriers, field entrances, cattle over/ under passes as may be agreed at the detailed design stage. •Any other works as may be required.

Work under fully designed government specifications entails excavation, material placement, and embankment regrading; installation of soil-filled rock slope protection along the waterside levee face; construction of buried launchable rock toes and launchable overbank trenches; development of planting benches integrated with instream woody material; import and placement of riprap; structural tie-ins with existing rock revetment features; and complete temporary site stabilization across disturbed soil areas. North American Industry Classification (NAICS) code: 237990, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction. Product or Service Code: Y1LC, Construction of Tunnels and Subsurface Structures. Small Business Administration (SBA) size standard: $45,500,000.00 annual revenue. The target price range is estimated to be $45,000,000.00 to $60,000,000.00.Requirement is a total (100%) Small Business set-aside.

title: Over the Horizon Naval Strike Missile Navigation Adapter
description: This Special Notice is issued to provide awareness of the release of a Request for Solutions (RFS) for an other transaction project in accordance with 10 U.S.C. 4022. This Special Notice has been issued as part of the Maritime Advanced Technology Consortium (MATAC) managed by Advanced Technology International (ATI) and administered by the Naval Surface Warfare Center, Port Hueneme Division. The primary goal of this prototype project is to develop, test, install, and provide follow-on engineering support for a shipboard navigation adapter hardware and software prototype solution. The project will encompass agile software development, hardware system integration, and translation interface coding.

title: Disposal Services for Medical Chemical Defense Materiel
description: This is a new enterprise requirement and there are no incumbents. See attached document(s) for full information. Submission: Email responses to Contract Specialist abraham.g.pottenger.civ@health.mil and Contracting Officer randy.o.barry2.civ@health.mil 2.0 Scope of Work Summary The Government requires a contractor to provide all personnel, equipment, facilities, and compliant materials for the secure collection, and destruction of hazardous and non-hazardous MCDM, from Military Treatment Facilities (MTFs) across Continental United States (CONUS), Alaska, Hawaii, and Outside the Continental United States (OCONUS). 2.1 Key Requirements Logistics: Provide all Department of Transportation (DOT)/Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) compliant shipping supplies (containers, liners, manifests) to government sites. MTFs will collect and package materials for destruction in contractor provided containers. Secure Disposal and DEA Compliance: Perform DEA compliant receipt, storage, and destruction of Schedule II�V controlled substances and MCDM at a licensed CONUS-based facility. Perform DEA and host-nation compliant receipt, storage, and destruction of Schedule II�V controlled substances and MCDM at an authorized OCONUS-based facility, or coordinate secure export to a licensed CONUS-based facility in accordance with international transport regulations. Regulatory Adherence: Maintain strict adherence to all DEA, EPA, DOT, FDA, other applicable federal and state regulations, and international regulations and transport treaties. Reporting: Provide Certificates of Destruction within 30 days of disposal and submit comprehensive monthly disposal reports. Maintain an online tracking portal for real-time shipment status and monthly disposal reports.

Supplementary Oxygen Capability for MV-75 Cheyenne
description: The Government is seeking information on portable, RORO supplementary oxygen system solutions that may support MV-75 aircrew during extended-duration, high-altitude self-deployment operations. The Government is interested in self-generating approaches that can be installed and removed with minimal aircraft impact and without primary reliance on fixed-base oxygen-generation or refill infrastructure. The Government is particularly interested in systems that: � Support a minimum of two pilots and one nonrated crewmember for approximately seven hours at pressure altitudes up to 18,000 feet. � Generate, distribute, and deliver or otherwise provide breathing oxygen without primary reliance on stored oxygen cylinders. Respondents should identify any required stored-oxygen reserve. � Can be installed without significant permanent aircraft modification or extensive changes to aircraft systems. � Fit within the currently allocated installation envelope of approximately 2.5 cubic feet, with nominal dimensions of 0.8 feet wide, 1.3 feet deep, and 2.3 feet high. Solutions exceeding this preferred envelope may be considered if necessary to meet the operational need. � Address applicable physiological performance considerations, including breathing flow, mask pressure, work of breathing, oxygen concentration, gas temperature, and contaminant control. The Government anticipates considering applicable portions of MIL-STD-3050 and/or MIL-PRF-27210, the Army Military Airworthiness Certification Criteria (AMACC), and guiding miliary aircraft requirements as appropriate. � Do not impede aircrew movement, emergency egress, or access to individual weapons and required survival equipment. See Attachment for full requirements and submission instructions.

The Defense Commissary Agency (DeCA) is seeking qualified, experienced sources capable of supplying, delivering, and installing standardized commercial gondola shelving systems across up to 12 selective worldwide commissary locations annually. Optional incidental services may include: offloading merchandise from existing shelves, dismantling and removal of existing shelving systems, and restocking merchandise onto newly installed shelving systems. title: C3BM ASE STRIKE Support
description: The Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) for Command, Control, Communications, and Battle Management (PAE C3BM) is a Department of the Air Force organization located at Hanscom Air Force Base, Massachusetts. However, they have multiple supporting locations across the continental United States (CONUS). PAE C3BM is responsible for the acquisition and delivery of the DAF BATTLE NETWORK, an integrated system-of-systems that connect sensors, effectors, and logistics systems to provide better situational awareness and faster decision-making for the joint force. This RFI focuses on experience related to systems engineering, architecture, and technical support to Department of Defense as well as modeling, knowledge management, data analysis, integration, and security. This RFI contains CUI and interested parties must be able to handle CUI and request access to the document through SAM.gov.

title: Bravo Dive Boat 65DS1101
description: AMENDMENT 0005 POSTED 12/5. RFC #16 Response available in Attachments. AMENDMENT 0004 POSTED 12/3. AMENDMENT 0003 POSTED 11/26. AMENDMENT 0002 POSTED 11/21. AMENDMENT 0001 POSTED 11/19. The Regional Maintenance Center at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard & Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS & IMF) intends to award a stand-alone Firm-Fixed-Price contract to accomplish the maintenance, repair, and preservation in support of one (1) 65 FT BRAVO DIVE BOAT 65DS1101. Work will be accomplished at the Contractor's facility. Geographical Area of consideration: To facilitate proper government oversight, the facility shall be located in the Puget Sound, WA region. For this procurement, the Puget Sound, WA region is defined as the West Coast of the continental US, starting from Olympia, WA and extending northward to Bellingham, WA. 65DS1101 Length: 69 FT 10 IN Width: 22 FT 0 IN Draft: 3 FT 6 IN Full Displacement: 55 L TONS Age: 13 YEARS Light Load: 8,000 lbs Hull Type: Aluminum Scope Overview: Coordinate with the Contracting Officer, via the Contracting Officer�s Representative (COR) to deliver the vessel to the Contractor�s facility from Puget Sound Naval Shipyard (PSNS) Bremerton, WA. Remove all fendering and sweep blast clean. Accomplish survey of hull to identify and repair corrosion, preserve the exterior above and below the waterline, including the crane. Apply nonskid to horizontal surfaces on the exterior and interior of the boat. Replace motor mounts. Remove, inspect and install shafting, rudders and propellers. HVAC repair. Maintain and repair watertight hatches and doors. Repair, modify and preserve push knee. Replace and modify corroded deck and bulkhead structure in the main cabin. Install remote fuel shut offs. Identify and repair corrosion beneath the transformers in the aft lazzarette, install a weather shield above the starboard transformer in the aft lazzarette. Replace hydraulic, and fuel hoses. Identify and repair corroded structure beneath the shower room drain. Remove windows, repair window heaters, and reinstall windows. Replace fire suppression system piping and recertify system. Repair damage to the port bow. Accomplish modification and repair of swim platform stairs. Restore preservation system on the console in the pilot house. Replace existing generators with supplied Kohler generators, Modify, repair and install fendering system. Modify and repair the monkey heater system. Remove, inspect, preserve and install rudders. Replace thru hull valves and flexible hoses. Replace false bulkheads in the shower room and head. Open, clean and inspect all tanks. Perform sea trials after completion of repairs and full cure time of preservation. Arrange and coordinate the delivery of the vessel back to the Government with the Contracting Officer via the COR. The Period of Performance is expected to be 25 March 2026 to 29 May 2026. This is a 100% Small Business set-aside under the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 336611, size standard 1,300 employees. All offerors must be registered with the System for Award Management (SAM) to receive award of Government contracts. Offerors are advised also that SAM representations and certifications can be completed electronically via the System for Award Management website at https://www.sam.gov. NOTE 1: Please pay particular attention to the inclusion of DFARS 252.232-7998 Obligations in Advance of Fiscal Year 2026 Funding (DEVIATION 2026-O0001). NOTE 2: Please review Request for Quote instructions regarding contract financing.

title: Y1DA--590-27-120 Replace Pneumatic Tube System
description: Presolicitation Notice Presolicitation Notice Page 3 of 3 590-27-120 Replace Pneumatic Tube System This is a pre-solicitation announcement for the Department of Veterans Affairs. The Network Contracting Office (NCO) 6 intends to release a solicitation for construction services for project 590-27-120 Replace Pneumatic Tube System at the Hampton VA Health Care System in Hampton, VA. The design/build contractor (DB) shall be responsible for all required work associated with the removal, disposal of the old system, and installation of the new system. They shall provide all tools, labor, materials, equipment, supervision, professional services, and expertise required to perform all necessary work for the removal, disposal, installation, and activation. The design/build shall remove all pneumatic tube equipment and hardware from the current system. Work includes design and engineering, investigation and verification of existing conditions, removal and disposal of the existing pneumatic tube system and associated equipment, and procurement and installation of a new system in designated areas of Building 110, including the Blood Draw area, Mechanical Room, Interstitial Room, Emergency Department, and Laboratory. This announcement is a 100% set-aside for Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB). The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code 236220, size standard $45M applies to this procurement. The Magnitude of Construction for this project is between $500,000 and $1,000,000. The approximate solicitation issue date is November 16th, 2026. The Government intends to award a Firm Fixed Price Contract within 120 days from quote receipt date. This notice is for informational purposes only and is not a request for submission of quotes. It is the responsibility of the potential offerors to bring all necessary personnel, inclusive of subcontractors, tooling, and materials necessary for any site visit. The government will NOT be providing paper copies of any solicitation, solicitation attachments or annexes, specifications, or drawings. The government will NOT be reimbursing any costs associated with attendance or quote preparation. To be eligible for award, the SDVOSB must be registered and verified in the Small Business Administration Dynamic Small Business Search (SBA DSBS) see the following website: https://veterans.certify.sba.gov/. Potential offerors are further advised that failure to register in the System for Award Management (SAM) database will render your firm ineligible for award. The solicitation will be available only via the Internet at the following address: https://sam.gov/. Information on how to register your company, view or receive updates to this notice, please access https://sam.gov/. Any amendments to the solicitation will not be emailed but will be posted at the SAM website. Offerors are responsible for obtaining solicitation documents from SAM and acknowledging all amendments to any subsequent solicitation. No paper copies of the impending solicitation will be furnished. No email, fax, or telephone inquiries will be answered as a result of this announcement. No other information regarding scope, dates, etc. is available until issuance of the solicitation. The date and time for site visit will be stated in the issued solicitation. No other site visits will be conducted.

title: Tilbudsindhentning - Kapitalforvaltning 2026
description: Egedal Kommune har til hensigt at indgå to rammeaftaler om kapitalforvaltning. Rammeaftalerne indgås med baggrund i Lov om kommunernes styrelses, § 44 samt bekendtgørelsen nr. 1525 af 28. oktober 2020 (Anbringelsesbekendtgørelsen) og i henhold til Egedal Kommunes Finansielle Politik. De to rammeaftaler om kapitalforvaltning har en samlet beløbsramme på op til 400 mio. DKK. Den ene rammeaftale (Delaftale 1) er et balanceret mandat med en forventet beløbsramme på op til 225 mio. DKK. Rammeaftalen for det balancerede mandat kan kun bestå af aktivklassefordelingen, der fastsættes i kommunens finansielle politik. Den anden rammeaftale (Delaftale 2) består af et mandat til en REPO-aftale til fortsat optimering af Egedal Kommunes driftslikviditet, med en forventet beløbsramme på op til 175 mio. DKK. Rammeaftalen for REPO-mandatet er underlagt krav om en portefølje bestående af danske stats- og realkreditobligationer. Beløbsrammen for rammeaftalerne er baseret på et estimat og er ikke forpligtende for ordregiver. Tilbudsgiver kan byde på begge rammeaftaler særskilt, eller blot én af rammeaftalerne. Tilbuddene vil blive vurderet pr. rammeaftale uafhængig af hinanden.

Beløbsrammen for rammeaftalerne er baseret på et estimat og er ikke forpligtende for ordregiver. Tilbudsgiver kan byde på begge rammeaftaler særskilt, eller blot én af rammeaftalerne. Das Grundstück wird im Norden und Nordwesten von der Straße Zur Ahrensdorfer Heide begrenzt. Das gegenüberliegende Grundstück ist noch unbebaut. Es handelt sich um eine Wohnbaufläche gem. B-Plan. Im Osten schließen ein Grünstreifen und ein kleinteiliges Einfamilienhauswohngebiet um den Notteweg und die Weserstraße an. Die zweigeschossige Sporthalle besteht aus einer Drei-Feld-Sporthalle, Nebenfunktionsflächen und einer Zuschauertribüne mit 114 Zuschauerplätze davon sind 2 Barrierefrei. Sportler und Besucher gelangen über einen gemeinsamen Haupteingang in das Foyer. Sie werden über das Treppenhaus 1 in das Obergeschoss geleitet. Dort befinden sich die Umkleide- und Waschräume. Die tragenden Bauteile werden als Stahlbetonkonstruktion erstellt. Das Sporthallendach besteht aus Holzbindern mit einer wärmegedämmten Stahltrapezblech Dachhaut. Die Gründung ist eine Stahlbetonbodenplatte mit Frostschürzen aus Betonstreifenfundamenten. Die Fassadenbekleidung besteht aus einem WDVS mit keramischem Fliesenbelag im Erdgeschoss und Putz im Obergeschoss. Die Fenster bestehen aus Kunststofffenster mit Aluabdeckung außen, Alu-Pfosten-Riegel-Fassaden und Bauprofilglasflächen. description: Bei der Baumaßnahme handelt es sich um Neubauten von zwei Unterkunftsgebäuden in der Löwensteinkaserne in Aachen. Sie gehört zu den Liegenschaften, die der BLB NRW NL Bundesbau für die BImA betreut und bearbeitet. Die Baukörper sind langgezogene, nicht unterkellerte dreigeschossige Riegel. Als oberer Abschluss wird ein Satteldach mit einer Neigung von 30° aufgesetzt. Im Dachraum werden Lüftungsleitungen verlegt, ansonsten bleibt das Geschoss ungenutzt. Die Gebäude werden in Massivbauweise errichtet. Der Dachstuhl wird aus einer Zimmermannskonstruktion aufgesetzt und mit Dachsteinen eingedeckt. Die Außenwände werden aus Stahlbeton hergestellt. Sie erhalten ein Wärmedämmverbundsystem. Die Fassade wird im Bereich des Erdgeschosses mit Klinkerriemchen verkleidet . Die restliche Fläche wird mit Scheibenputz versehen.
